name: match-guard-analysis-test-cf5a6832da/match-guard-function-method-call-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value: cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString

Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType; value:fromJsonWithType; value:toString and value:toBalString
reason: The asserted negative diagnostics concern function/method invocation isolation and argument safety inside match guards, but the test fundamentally uses list match patterns and mapping binding match patterns outside the explicitly supported const/wildcard pattern subset. It also depends on unsupported lang.value clone and cloneReadOnly calls, both qualified and via method syntax. Thus the complete case is outside subset 10 despite support for isolated functions/classes and ordinary calls.
unsupported_constructs: List match patterns such as [1, 2, 3] and [1, ...var r]
Mapping binding match patterns such as var {x, y}
test_design_notes: Negative test with inline @error markers; rejecting unsupported patterns alone would not establish the intended guard isolation and mutable-argument diagnostics.
